leads.claim: The witness claims to have observed a living creature inside a machine that performed unexpected maneuvers.
leads.why: The claim describes an observation of a creature inside a vehicle but provides no evidence of physical custody or material recovery.
leads.material_description: A living creature inside a machine.
leads.quote: I felt there was a living creature in it.

doc_verdict: The document contains no evidence of the government or contractors obtaining, analyzing, or holding physical UAP material; it consists of anecdotal accounts of sightings and radar observations.
